input.goal: Dredge each Chicken-cheese ball into flour, then dip into egg and roll in the breadcrumbs, ensuring the entire surface of the chicken ball is covered in breadcrumbs.

sub_goals.text: Set up the breadcrumbs in a bowl
Store the breadcrumbs container and prepare the flour bowl
Retrieve flour from the cabinet and pour it into the bowl
Form the first chicken ball and coat it with flour
Dip the first chicken ball in egg and coat it with breadcrumbs
Form the second chicken ball and coat it with flour
Dip the second chicken ball in egg, sprinkle with more flour, and coat it with breadcrumbs

l3_relation_types.temporal_order: which of two events (from different sub-goals) happened first in the activity; the Solver sees the two segments in a SHUFFLED order and must infer the order from state cues (flour already on the ball, pan already full)
l3_relation_types.object_continuity: the same object / ingredient appears in both events; what happened to it between them (chopped broccoli -> in the pan)
l3_relation_types.state_change: how the state of an object differs between the two events (whole -> chopped, empty -> full, raw -> browned)
l3_relation_types.causal_prerequisite: the earlier event is a physical prerequisite of the later one (could not be done without it)
l3_relation_types.hidden_state: an appliance / container state was set in the earlier event and is not visible in the later segment; what is its state at the end of the later segment

plan.goal: Dredge each Chicken-cheese ball into flour, then dip into egg and roll in the breadcrumbs, ensuring the entire surface of the chicken ball is covered in breadcrumbs.

events.description: Pour breadcrumbs from a container into a bowl.
events.relevance: Prepares the breadcrumbs station for coating.

events.description: The rustling sound of dry breadcrumbs falling into the bowl.
events.relevance: Confirms the breadcrumbs are being dispensed.
Clears the workspace for the next steps.

events.description: Place an empty bowl on the counter for the flour.
events.relevance: Prepares the receptacle for the flour station.

events.description: Take the flour container from the cabinet.
events.relevance: Obtains the necessary ingredient for dredging.

events.description: Pour flour into the empty bowl.
events.relevance: Sets up the flour station for coating.

events.description: Shape the chicken and cheese mixture into a ball with hands.
events.relevance: Creates the core item to be coated.

events.description: Place the chicken ball into the flour bowl and roll it around.
events.relevance: Applies the first layer of the dredging process.

events.description: Transfer the flour-coated chicken ball into the egg bowl and turn it.
events.relevance: Applies the binder layer so breadcrumbs will stick.

events.description: Move the egg-coated chicken ball into the breadcrumbs bowl and roll it until covered.
events.relevance: Completes the final coating layer for the first ball.

events.description: Shape a second portion of chicken and cheese mixture into a ball.
events.relevance: Creates the second item to be coated.

events.description: Place the second chicken ball into the flour bowl and roll it.
events.relevance: Applies the first layer of the dredging process to the second ball.

events.description: Transfer the second chicken ball into the egg bowl.
events.relevance: Applies the binder layer to the second ball.

events.description: Sprinkle additional flour onto the chicken ball.
events.relevance: Ensures the ball is fully dry/coated before the final breadcrumb layer.

events.description: Move the second chicken ball into the breadcrumbs bowl and roll it.
events.relevance: Completes the final coating layer for the second ball.

relations.ask: Why was the flour poured into the bowl before the chicken ball was placed in it?
relations.answer_hint: The flour must be in the bowl to coat the chicken ball.

relations.ask: What happens to the chicken ball formed in the first event by the time of the second event?
relations.answer_hint: It gets coated in flour, then egg, and finally breadcrumbs.

relations.ask: Which coating step happened first for the first chicken ball?
relations.answer_hint: The ball is rolled in flour before being transferred to the egg bowl.

relations.ask: How does the appearance of the second chicken ball change between these two events?
relations.answer_hint: It goes from a raw, uncoated mixture to being fully covered in breadcrumbs.

relations.ask: Which dry ingredient was poured into its bowl first?
relations.answer_hint: The breadcrumbs were poured before the flour.

decision_points.why: The person must decide to clear the workspace by storing the breadcrumbs container before setting up the next station.
The person must decide which ingredient to retrieve next (flour) to continue setting up the dredging stations.
The person transitions from preparing the stations to actually forming the first chicken ball.
The person must decide to move the ball from the flour to the egg and breadcrumbs, following the correct dredging sequence.
The person decides to start the process over for a second chicken ball rather than doing something else.
The person must decide to move the second ball through the remaining coating steps, including an extra sprinkle of flour.
The task is complete once the second ball is fully coated in breadcrumbs, requiring a decision to stop or move to cooking.
